items.exampleEn: The old poem is about eternal love.
items.exampleZh: 這首老詩講的是永恆的愛。

items.exampleEn: My grandfather has a lifelong love of music.
items.exampleZh: 我爺爺一輩子都熱愛音樂。

items.exampleEn: The sky turns orange at sunset.
items.exampleZh: 日落時天空會變成橘色。

items.exampleEn: The weather forecast says it will rain tomorrow.
items.exampleZh: 氣象預報說明天會下雨。

items.exampleEn: Her words had a lasting effect on me.
items.exampleZh: 她說的話對我產生了持久的影響。

items.exampleEn: The baby cried continuously for an hour.
items.exampleZh: 寶寶連續哭了一個小時。

items.exampleEn: We got up early to see the sunrise.
I could hear the clock ticking in the quiet room.
items.exampleZh: 在安靜的房間裡，我聽得到時鐘滴答響。

items.sentenceEn: The clock on the wall ticked loudly during the test.
items.sentenceZh: 考試時，牆上的時鐘滴答滴答響得很大聲。

items.audioEn: Let's leave the beach after the sunset and have dinner in town.
items.audioZh: 我們看完日落再離開海灘，到鎮上吃晚餐吧。
items.questionZh: 說話者建議什麼時候離開海灘？
options: Once the sun has gone down

items.sentenceEn: Learning English can be a lifelong journey.
items.sentenceZh: 學英文可以是一輩子的旅程。

items.sentenceEn: The machine worked continuously from morning until night.
items.sentenceZh: 這台機器從早到晚不停地運轉。

items.stemEn: According to the ____, it will be cold this weekend.
items.stemZh: 根據氣象預報，這個週末會很冷。

items.stemEn: The trip to the mountains left a ____ memory; I still think about it.
items.stemZh: 那趟山上之旅留下了持久的回憶，我到現在還會想起。

items.passageEn: Every year, many people go up Alishan to watch the sunrise. Last month, Nina and her husband did the same. The forecast said the sky would be clear, so they left their hotel at four in the morning. They stood in the cold for an hour, waiting. When the sun finally came up, nobody said a word. Nina wished the beautiful moment could be eternal. It became a lasting memory, and next time they plan to watch the sunset there.
items.passageZh: 每年都有很多人上阿里山看日出。上個月，Nina 和她先生也去了。氣象預報說天空會很晴朗，所以他們凌晨四點就離開飯店。他們在寒風中站著等了一個小時。太陽終於升起時，沒有人說一句話。Nina 希望這美好的一刻能成為永恆。這成了一段持久的回憶，下次他們打算去那裡看日落。

questions.questionZh: 他們為什麼凌晨四點就離開飯店？

items.promptZh: 我們每年夏天都會去海邊看日落。
referenceEn: We go to the beach to watch the sunset every summer.
Every summer, we go to the seaside to see the sunset.
rubricZh: sunset 前通常加 the（例如 watch the sunset）
每年的習慣多用現在簡單式，其他合理時態也接受
every summer 可放在句首、句尾等位置

items.promptZh: 她和她的鄰居是一輩子的好朋友。
referenceEn: She and her neighbor are lifelong friends.
She and her neighbor have been lifelong friends.
rubricZh: 用 lifelong 修飾名詞，表示「一輩子的」（例如 lifelong friends）
時態配合內容（例如 are、have been 等）
